name: IKS Emissary
_comment: R3.59, Module R3 SSD book page 19. Corner reads YS:171 DK:6 EX:16 CR:6; the annex agrees on
crew 42 and 12 boarding parties, and gives the point value as 125/110.
The D5 hull in its diplomatic fit, and the sister of the D7N we already carry — the two sheets
share their notes almost word for word. Against the plain D5 it gives up BOTH DRONE RACKS and
keeps the ADDs, which is why there are only fourteen weapons here; it also carries one fewer
tractor (2 rather than 3) and a UIM as standard.
Two notes printed on the sheet that we do NOT model, recorded so nobody looks for them:
- 'NO MUTINY', spelled out in the data table, with the reason beside the crew track: 'THIS
SHIP IS EXEMPT FROM MUTINY AS A DIPLOMATIC SHIP (G6.14)'. Mutiny is not built; when it is,
this hull and the D7N are the exemptions.
- 'THIS SHIP CAN CONTROL A NUMBER OF SEEKING WEAPONS EQUAL TO HALF ITS SENSOR RATING' — a
halved seeking-weapon control limit, which the D7N's sheet also carries. Our drone control
G6.12 names the diplomatic ships as the Klingon exception that HAS a flag bridge, but neither
this sheet nor the D7N's draws a flag box — the boom runs BRIDGE, EMER, SCTY and stops. So no
`flag` is declared here, and a flag-bridge hit converts to a security station like any other
Klingon ship (Annex #7E). Checked rather than assumed: the alternative was inventing a box the
_refitComment: The data table lists one refit: K REFIT (Y175) = +2. The sheet says which phasers it touches —
'PHASER-2s MARKED K ARE CHANGED TO PHASER-1s ON THE K REFIT' — and the two marked ones are the
wing phaser-2s, 3 and 4, exactly as on the D5. The forward pair are already phaser-1s.
